EXAMINATION:  CT HEAD W/O CONTRAST

INDICATION:  ___ with altered mental status  // acute process?

without the administration of IV contrast.  Reformatted coronal, sagittal and
thin section bone algorithm-reconstructed images were then generated.

COMPARISON:  None.

large territorial infarction.  The ventricles and sulci are normal in size and
configuration.  Subcortical and periventricular white matter hypodensities are
consistent with chronic small vessel ischemic disease.
The basal cisterns appear patent and there is preservation of gray-white
matter differentiation.

The left zygomatic arch deformity is probably chronic as there is no
associated soft tissue swelling. Metallic density is noted left frontal
process of the maxilla.  The paranasal sinuses, mastoid air cells, and middle
ear cavities are clear.
The globes are unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:

The left zygomatic arch deformity is probably chronic as there is no
associated soft tissue swelling.
